specs.title: actual range rewiring, reverse, over-range, invalid multi-range and reset clear stale readings
both meter scales stay visible with independent divisions, active-range highlighting and no attached wire letters on the dial
delayed old Worker messages after reset cannot overwrite a newer run or leave extra workers active
lamp glass, filament and halo follow actual power continuously without a rated-power plateau
touch places and connects a real lamp and the correct meter terminals
physical apparatus and single-cell battery preview replace symbols; loose wire can be dropped, moved, bent and rewired
touch can move a loose wire, bend it and attach both ends to actual posts
series multi-point acquisition, table, current/voltage chart, CSV and reload use the same frozen snapshots
hand-copied estimates, missing values and explicit corrections never get overwritten by model truth
over-range and model-failure samples stay blank, stale paused samples are blocked and corrupt snapshots cannot replace work
different parallel lamps record real branch currents and equal branch voltages; CSV neutralizes text formulas
touch acquisition and chart controls remain usable without page horizontal overflow
experiment rename validates and cancels, supports undo/redo, persists and names the exported file
one drag is one history transaction; undo/redo, cancelled drag, delete restoration and export agree
blank assembly saves to IndexedDB, refresh restores exact structure, editing and explicit load continue
bad and oversized imports preserve current work; supported v1 migrates after a cancellable inert preview
blocked local storage still allows editing and JSON export without claiming saved
failed save leaves the last committed IndexedDB snapshot intact
corrupt local data does not replace current work and JSON backup can recover after refresh
library drag creates a physical four-post rheostat; live wiper preview drives lamp/meters without saving or sampling until one committed move
A-B remains fixed, C-D stays a conductor and the opposite lower terminal reverses adjustment
low zoom keeps all four posts distinct; wire reconnection and Delete preserve rheostat endpoint positions

specs.title: touch slides a rotated flipped wiper, commits once and rolls pointer cancellation back
saving a second experiment preserves the first; loading, renaming and resaving update only the selected document
different experiments with identical names remain separate by document ID
upgrading a v1 single-slot database preserves its remaining snapshot and adds it to the experiment list
delete requires confirmation, targets the selected ID and leaves current work and other saved experiments intact
deleting the current latest save preserves the board, selects another startup save, and deleting all never resurrects old data
a deletion failure rolls back both experiment and latest snapshot and keeps the saved marker
Delete keeps all wires at the deleted rotated apparatus posts; text editing is safe, undo and reload preserve exact structure
Shift toggles multi-selection including switch handles and keyboard; Delete and inspector remove the group as one undo step
wire crossing a meter stays visible and selectable while actual terminal centres remain connectable
